local_rewrite_results.point_context:
### One generation, different travel tastes

The same age group is not one market. Among women aged 29 and under, gourmet travel was the top choice at about half, while visiting famous destinations remained high at about 45%. That is different from the pattern seen among young men. Travel businesses and destinations may therefore need more than one Gen Z model: flexible, interest-led options alongside landmark-based itineraries.
